The Changes pane measures its tree once per redraw instead of twice, so scrolling a long diff does less work.

- desk-look: the top and bottom buttons and the position bar added in 0.74.0 estimated the height of the diff tree, and the Changes pane then estimated it a second time to place `n`/`p` on file headers. It now reads the first estimate. Nothing on screen changes
- desk-asana, desk-slack and desk-review take the same copy of the shared helper, with no change in behaviour
- desk-plan and desk-grant move to 0.74.1 with no changes

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
